channel.title: Ayam Labs - build notes and guides
channel.description: Five small APIs on Cloudflare Workers: email verification, on-page SEO audit, document text extraction, text analysis and PII redaction.

item.title: Five APIs on Cloudflare Workers, and the four bugs that nearly shipped
item.description: Building five production APIs on Cloudflare Workers: the architecture, the pricing maths, and the four bugs that would have made them useless.

item.title: Redact PII before you send text to an LLM | Ayam Labs
item.description: What leaks when customer text reaches a model prompt, which detectors catch it, and how to redact with labels so the model can still follow the conversation.

item.title: How to verify an email address without sending mail
item.description: What an email verification API can actually check without SMTP, how to read the score, and where the approach stops working.

item.title: Audit a page's on-page SEO with one HTTP request
item.description: The on-page signals that decide whether a page can rank, how to read them from a single audit response, and what the audit cannot tell you.

item.title: Extract text from a PDF in a serverless function
item.description: Why PDF parsing breaks in edge runtimes, and how to get clean text, page counts and metadata from one POST without bundling a parser.

item.title: Sentiment and keyword extraction without an LLM bill
item.description: Deterministic text analysis you can run on every row, when to pay for a model instead, and how to read the confidence numbers.

item.title: Redact PII before it reaches a log or a model
item.description: Detecting emails, phones, cards and tokens in text, choosing between redact, mask and hash, and why offsets matter more than counts.
